issues.where: crop C upper-center sky (also image-03.png crop M upper-left and image-01.png upper-right sky between planet and Sun)
issues.what: a straight, slightly tilted horizontal patch edge cuts across the sky: dense stars and Milky Way dust appear below the line while the region above drops abruptly to empty black space
issues.fix: extend a single seamless starfield across the entire sky background and blend solar glare over it without hard rectangular layer borders

issues.where: crop L sunlit right limb (also image-02.png crops C and E, and image-01.png right limb)
issues.what: the sunlit planet edge shows hard 1-pixel stair-stepped aliasing sitting inside a uniform, detached orange rim halo
issues.fix: render the globe silhouette with clean subpixel anti-aliasing and remove or physically integrate the artificial orange outer glow layer

issues.where: crop L sunlit hemisphere and limb (also image-02.png crops G, C, and E)
issues.what: the brightly lit surface becomes soft, blurry, and flat-lit compared to the crisp terminator, with craters near the sunlit limb stretched into flat painted outlines lacking geometric relief
issues.fix: use higher-resolution albedo and displacement maps on the sunlit hemisphere so crater rims retain sharp micro-relief and proper foreshortening right to the horizon

issues.where: crop E right sky and crop I left-side starfield (also image-03.png crop R and image-04.png crop V)
issues.what: many stars near the lower-right limb are multi-pixel smeared blobs and short worm-like clumps, noticeably softer and coarser than stars further right in crop I
issues.fix: render background stars at uniform crisp point-spread sharpness without upscaled or denoised blob artifacts

issues.where: crop C middle-right solar corona transition (also image-03.png crop M left-center)
issues.what: faint horizontal streaks and banding run across the dusty solar glow where the corona overlaps the starfield patch
issues.fix: dither and smooth the coronal falloff in higher bit depth and remove horizontal compositing streaks
